units.title: Sample report on a licence-clean public Freqtrade strategy
acceptance: one sample verification report under verification/sample/, generated from committed inputs
the strategy's licence permits redistribution of the report; licence and source pinned by commit
no customer code or data
tests/test_verification_*.py cover the report's reproducibility; full suite 0 failed

units.title: Minimum intake / triage
acceptance: intake form, intake checklist and triage rubric under verification/intake/
the form collects no secret, exchange key or credential and says so
no database, no web service

units.title: Minimum isolated runner
acceptance: sandboxed execution of a customer or public strategy
no network for untrusted strategy code
pinned engine / container image
no customer code or data committed
uses existing repository capabilities and interfaces AS-IS
does NOT modify research/cycle2/**

units.title: Protected driver/funnel generalisation
acceptance: touches research/cycle2/** (protected): OWNER_MERGE_REQUIRED
NOT a prerequisite for CV-03 and never opened automatically pre-paid
opened only on an EXISTING_INTERFACE_BLOCKER demonstrated by the minimum runner, or PAID_CASE_MANUAL_WORK showing repeated work the generalisation removes
every existing Cycle-2 test passes unchanged; no funnel threshold or law changes
units.notes: Do not generalise the scientific engine merely because it may eventually be useful.

units.title: Automate a step with recorded manual minutes in a paid case
acceptance: automates only the step named in a manual_minutes ticket
inside verification/** only

units.title: One-command verification case
acceptance: one command runs a full case end to end on the isolated runner
built only if recorded demand supports it

value_gates.allows: CV-01 sample report, CV-02 intake, CV-03 minimum isolated runner
CV-1x: automate only steps with recorded manual minutes in a paid case
CV-MVP if recorded demand supports it

stop_law.zero_paid_outcome: STOP commercial building; a pivot needs a charter amendment merged by the Owner
